name: paperify-md
description: Export Markdown files to DOCX with Pandoc templates and Mermaid diagram support.

paperifyMd.mermaidCliPath.description: Path to the Mermaid CLI executable (mmdc). Required only when the Markdown file contains mermaid code fences.

paperifyMd.referenceDocx.description: Optional path to a reference DOCX template. If empty, the extension will first look for reference.docx next to the Markdown file, then use the bundled template selected by paperifyMd.referenceLanguage.

enumDescriptions: Automatically detect Markdown language: choose Chinese template when Chinese content is dominant, otherwise English.
Use the bundled English CSCI reference DOCX based on the official CSCI/IJMLC template.
Use the bundled Chinese CSSCI common reference DOCX.
paperifyMd.referenceLanguage.description: Bundled reference DOCX language used when paperifyMd.referenceDocx is empty and no local reference.docx exists next to the Markdown file.

paperifyMd.outputDirectory.description: Optional output directory for exported DOCX files. Relative paths are resolved from the Markdown file folder.

paperifyMd.mermaidOutputFormat.description: Rendered image format for mermaid diagrams before conversion.

paperifyMd.openAfterExport.description: After export, open the generated DOCX location. On Windows, the file is selected in Explorer to avoid shell association pop-up failures.

paperifyMd.keepIntermediateFiles.description: Keep temporary markdown and rendered mermaid assets for debugging.
